title: querylog.py close --tried closes an eval finding apply left no-fix, and the stranded detector leaves it alone
goal: querylog.py close F --tried NOTE (ql_research) also accepts an eval finding whose newest record is no-fix: it records the finding tried with the dated NOTE (no _gaps.md entry for an eval finding), and bl_intake's stranded detector skips a tried eval finding until the note is older than QUEUE_TRIED_DAYS; a gap finding keeps today's rules. Planted: a no-fix eval finding closed --tried is no longer stranded, and one past QUEUE_TRIED_DAYS is again. The operator's call for F-b28d0d79b19b and F-fe10582bc61f (BG-leuzxnns, BG-wl242jco): once it lands they are closed --tried and the two bugs dropped.

run:
import sys, os, json, subprocess, tempfile, datetime
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_intake, ql_research
n = ql_research.QUEUE_TRIED_DAYS
t = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).date()
d = lambda k: (t - datetime.timedelta(days=k)).isoformat()
run = f"{(t - datetime.timedelta(days=n + 20)):%Y%m%d}T100000Z-00000001"
def rec(i, **k):
    return {"id": i, "kind": "eval", "state": "no-fix", **k}
recs = [rec("F-a", tried=d(n - 2)), rec("F-b", tried=d(n + 5)), rec("F-c"),
        rec("F-d", kind="gap", state="open", stage="candidate-gap", tried=d(n - 2))]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as r:
    p = os.path.join(r, bl_intake.STORE_REL, "findings", run[:4] + "-" + run[4:6], run + ".jsonl")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p))
    open(p, "w").write("".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in [{"run": run}] + recs))
    g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", *a], cwd=r, check=True, capture_output=True)
    g("init", "-q"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-q", "-m", "s")
    got = sorted(x[0]["id"] for x in bl_intake.stranded_findings(r))
assert got == ["F-b", "F-c", "F-d"], got
